transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
DeepSeek's new model boosts performance scores and cuts operating costs, with API access now open. Reported by 联合早报.
DeepSeek API now offers web search capabilities, charging 5 yuan per 1000 requests starting November 1. Reported by 21财经.
Alice and AI21 trained NVIDIA models to resist hackers and reduce sycophantic chatbot behavior. Reported by Ynetnews.
Anthropic warns of self-replicating AI worms threatening smart devices, citing weak security and rapid capability growth. Still open, per The Guardian.
Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because artificial intelligence agents now work six times more hours than humans. Reported by The Decoder.
Free every hour.
